name: Pho
summary: Pho is a beef or chicken noodle soup in a clear broth. Northern bowls are plainer. Southern bowls come with a sweeter broth and a pile of herbs and lime.
origin: The soup is associated with Hanoi, where pho bo is the breakfast standard. The south adapted it with more sugar and more garnish.
howToEat: Eat it at breakfast or lunch. Taste the broth before you add anything.
In the south, herbs, bean sprouts, and lime arrive on a plate. Add them as you go. In Hanoi, the bowl is often considered finished when it reaches you.
A busy morning shop with a short menu is the right room.
priceBand: A basic bowl is often a cheap street or shop meal. Confirm the board price.
seoTitle: Pho — what it is, how to eat it, where it is from
seoDescription: How pho differs between Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, and how to order a bowl.
